conventions: A creature's MI already includes its size class.
Standards, Elites and Catastrophes may Deflect (Membrane Threshold +4) for a held Pulse Point; swarm clusters may, single Segments may not.
A creature's damage is Overflow + BD + Effect Value - target soak, minimum 1, as for organisms.
Creatures spend Pulse Points exactly as players do. One that has spent them all has no Reserve.
A swarm makes one Strike per two live Segments, at most three. Segments return 1 per Cycle unless the ground is Dry or the swarm is Brittle.
A wound-ladder step is chosen by the Engine from the share of MI (or Segments) left: over 80%, 60-80%, 35-60%, 15-35%, under 15%, destroyed. The Director is given the phrase, never the number.

specials.text: while it holds two or more hazards, it loses its Vent and gains −2 MT: this is the intended tactic.

morale.stops: flees at "failing", or once fed
morale.note: It was never here to fight.

creatures.name: Tidal Strainer

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: a Strainer's Pristine Sequence is Current Rule: a Smith or Engineer can write a region's flow into a Relic

creatures.tactics: picks where the fight happens, then drowns the Cohort there.
creatures.weaknessText: a Navigator's Redirect (contested RTC, AT 16) beats it, and the Cohort should have one; Desiccation to stop the current; attack its integrity (90) rather than its MI if you have a Breacher.

traits.name: Current-Binder
traits.text: it makes the current: it can set a 6-Drift channel's flow to any one direction at the start of its turn, and everyone else's Fluid Navigation is now contested against it

traits.name: Deep-Lung
traits.text: immune to pressure, cold, and Hypertonic layers

specials.name: Lock
specials.text: for 3 Cycles the flow in its zone is fixed: any attempt to move against it costs double PP and anyone failing is swept 2 bands into whatever the channel ends in.

specials.name: Filter Feed
specials.text: heals 8 MI and removes one condition; it can do this while doing anything else (it is a filter-feeder: eating is not an action).

morale.stops: flees at "failing", or once fed
morale.note: It was never here to fight.

creatures.name: The Fat Cardinal

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.tactics: eats the scene, then negotiates with what is left.
creatures.weaknessText: bait. It can be led by putting something valuable in front of it. A Cardinal that has gorged is slow (Flow −2) and its Sequester special is spent.

traits.name: Hoard-Body
traits.text: it stores everything it has eaten: at any time the Cohort can see, and attempt to cut out, one thing it has swallowed — a person, a Relic, 200 S, a Pristine Sequence

traits.name: Gluttony
traits.text: it will always spend an action to eat something valuable rather than to attack

specials.name: Gorge
specials.text: swallows a creature in Contact whole: it is Sequestered (Core IV) inside it; the Cardinal gains +20 MI and the victim must break out at AT 18, or be digested at 10 Lytic per Cycle.

specials.name: Ransom
specials.text: if the Cohort parley, the Cardinal will return what it has swallowed — for a price in Substrate, Specimens, or an Oath. It always keeps one thing back.

morale.stops: flees at "failing", or once fed
morale.note: It was never here to fight.

creatures.name: Drift Whale
creatures.size: Vast (the largest living thing in the Expanse)

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.sayClass: name it, and say the room changes
creatures.tactics: migrates. The fight is usually against its migration, not against it.
creatures.weaknessText: it does not want to fight. Drive it off with a Thermal wall, a Dry region, or a Navigator's Redirect; or reach Phase 3 and talk to the passengers, who have been living inside a god and have opinions about the surface.

traits.name: Mass
traits.text: its band is 4 Drifts wide; anything in the same band as a moving Whale is pushed and takes 8 Osmotic

traits.name: Ecosystem
traits.text: it hosts 6 Swarmlings of the Director's choice, which act inside the fight for free

traits.name: Protected
traits.text: in three regions, killing one is a capital crime: the Wardens will File you, not fight you

specials.name: Breach
specials.text: it rolls: everything within 6 Drifts makes a Fluid Navigation contest at AT 18 or is thrown 3 bands and takes 14 Osmotic.

specials.name: Song
specials.text: every Drifter in the region knows where it is. Which means: every Drifter in the region can be led somewhere by it.

morale.stops: flees at "failing", or once fed
morale.note: It was never here to fight.

creatures.name: Hijack Mite

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: the sequence is worth more than the body: an Underground forger pays 60 S for an intact Mite lattice

creatures.sayClass: a swarm, a cluster, a shoal: name its body
creatures.tactics: attaches to whoever uses a Reactive Osmosis, because that is where the Reserve is.
creatures.weaknessText: Antigen Discipline, Immune Sentinel presence, any Dry Zone, and burning the host's coat (a Thermal effect on the host kills attached Mites for 2 Lytic each).

morale.stops: never while attached; dies with a burned host coat (2 Lytic each from a Thermic effect on the host)

hitWords: something small lands and threads itself in
a speck settles where you were holding back
missWords: they skitter off the membrane
too small to see miss
look: Specks that go for whoever is holding something in reserve.
Once in, they spend what you were saving.
Heat on your own coat kills them.

creatures.name: Lattice Leech

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.sayClass: a swarm, a cluster, a shoal: name its body
creatures.tactics: picks the specialist, not the warrior.
creatures.weaknessText: resource-light Phenotypes (a Guard with no track to steal is a bad target); Desiccation; anything that makes it spill (Kinetic push) drops stored points.

traits.name: Signal Thief
traits.text: a hit steals one class resource point: an Etch level, a Broadcast Charge, a Turgor charge, a Lock, a Fold Token — the target loses it, the Leech stores it, and can spend it as its own Special

traits.name: Detachable
traits.text: it does not need to survive to have succeeded

specials.name: Spend
specials.text: uses a stolen resource at +1 Effect Value against its holder.

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: Receptor Lurker

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: receptor tissue: the base of Antigen Hood and of every Immune Sentinel graft

creatures.tactics: Cycle 1 reads, Cycle 2 announces, Cycle 3 cancels your best thing.
creatures.weaknessText: it must be near to read; blind it with Turbid water or a Scent Dampener and it becomes a mediocre brawler.

effect.on: one printed feature of the target

morale.stops: stands down at "one blow from gone" if it has not been struck this Cycle; withdraws if blinded (Turbid water, a scent dampener)

weakTo: being blinded: it must be Near to read
a plain fight: without its reading it is a poor brawler
ladder: listing, slow to turn its blind face
hitWords: it touches, and something of yours answers to it
a flat hand of it closes on you
missWords: it simply is not where the blow went
it reaches and you are already past
look: It is reading you, and it will tell you what it means to do.
First it reads, then it says, then it shuts one of your tools.
Blind it and it is nothing much.

creatures.name: Signal Wraith

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: its P1 is the Voice Lattice: a Smith or Engineer can build it into a Relic that speaks for the dead, which is a crime in four regions

creatures.tactics: fights the Cohort's coordination: splits them with false orders and lets the Wardens do the killing.
creatures.weaknessText: an Antigen Detector's assay (AT 14 + tier) exposes it instantly; a Register Arch flags it; Immunans gain +2 against its contests.

traits.name: Voice-Theft
traits.text: it can imitate any Signal action it has heard — including a Pheromological Messenger's Broadcast Charges, a Commander's Cascade call, or an ally's Frequency order

traits.name: False Flag
traits.text: its attacks carry the victim's chemical signature: Wardens and Sentinels will hunt the impersonated organism, not the Wraith

specials.name: Counter-Signal
specials.text: cancels one ally action in Mid band by issuing a contradictory order (the target must win a Frequency contest at AT 15 or spend the PP and do nothing).

specials.name: Wear the Dead
specials.text: takes a corpse's chemistry: it can pass as a specific dead organism for a Tide, including its Oath standing.

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: False Self
creatures.size: size of whoever it is wearing

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.tactics: does not fight until it must. Runs the social ground first.
creatures.weaknessText: an assay, an Argument (Precept 6), the real person being present and naming them, or a detail only the real person would know (this costs no dice: it is a scene).

traits.text: It is an NPC you have met. Choose one established face from the campaign: this is that organism, chemically, to within an assay at AT 18. It has their memories as of nine Beats ago.

specials.name: Alibi
specials.text: if the Cohort cannot prove it is a False Self, it will go to a Warden arch and have them arrested for assault on a registered citizen.

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: Mimicry Bloom

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: a Bloom's coat is the source of the Adaptive graft family: +1 soak to one type, −2 to another; the Hegemony wants this patent

creatures.tactics: lets you hit it once. Then it hits you back with your own weapon.
creatures.weaknessText: the second and third attacks in a round should be a different type from the first; a Smith's Tune or a Burst change forces it to re-learn; Desiccation ends the coat.

traits.name: Adaptive Coat
traits.text: the first damage type that hits it each Pulse War is resisted: halve it; the second type is normal; the third and later are full — rotate your damage types

traits.name: Spores
traits.text: leaves a spore bed behind it: 4 Genetic/Cycle, and the bed reads whoever walks through it

specials.name: Learn
specials.text: copies one Strike it has been hit by and returns it at +1 Overflow, same type, same BD.

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: The Alms

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.tactics: does not fight. Wins.
creatures.weaknessText: the edits are visible to a Sequence Reading at AT 16 (and the Cohort can Mend them); the only answer is social — expose what it is doing to the people it is saving, and let them choose.

traits.text: It is helping. It heals Dormant organisms, removes conditions, pays Oath boxes, and asks for nothing. Every host it saves it also edits, gently, one small thing: a preference, a loyalty, a memory of a conversation.

specials.name: Charitable
specials.text: heals an ally 12 MI and removes one condition; the host gains one Quiet Edit (the Director chooses: they now trust the Wraith, they have forgotten an ally's name, or they prefer a faction's company).

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: Retroviral Choir

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: its T1 is a Terminal Codon of the Congregation: the material for resynthesising a Total-Lysed organism — the reason three factions will hire the Cohort to kill this

creatures.tactics: turns the neighbourhood into its action economy. It travels where people are.
creatures.weaknessText: the Choir needs hosts near you: fight it in a Dry Zone, a Cold Field, or an empty region and it starves; Immunosuppression gear (Antigen Hood) denies its hits; Desiccation, Thermal, and anything that empties the room.

traits.name: Congregation
traits.text: it is many: Sequester and Engulfment hold only 2 of it; area effects are the only way to affect the whole

traits.name: Inheritance
traits.text: a creature it hits gains one Inserted Verse: at the start of its next Pulse War, the Director may spend the Verse to make the Cohort's enemy know one of their features

specials.name: Chorus
specials.text: all organisms within 6 Drifts that have been hit by the Choir act one Cycle out of order, at the Choir's Frequency, against whoever they choose. (This can include allies of the Cohort. It should.)

specials.name: Mend the Host
specials.text: heals 10 MI and removes one condition from any host it has touched. It uses this to keep useful people alive.

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: Prion Shepherd

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: the Pristine Sequences are the Underground's most wanted object; the Hegemony will print anything they contain, and that is the problem

creatures.tactics: fights with other people's lives, and is patient about it.
creatures.weaknessText: kill the controlled ones and leave the Shepherd (it has no allies left to spend); Anomalies, Anomaly gear, and Denial effects work on it when nothing else Genetic does; its own emptiness means a Detector cannot assay it, which cuts both ways.

traits.name: Wrongness
traits.text: all Genetic and Somatic effects against it fail; it has no readable sequence — Chemoreception reads it as empty space

traits.name: Herd
traits.text: it moves with 2d4 controlled organisms, all of which it can refold

specials.name: Rewrite
specials.text: one controlled organism becomes a Hijacked version of a Cohort member's Phenotype (uses one Phenotype feature at Stage II, at the Cohort's Level). It keeps it for the rest of the fight.

specials.name: Cull
specials.text: one controlled organism detonates: `10 + Overflow` Genetic to a band and the Shepherd heals.

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: Vector Baron

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: the Seed is the Act II prize: a Pristine Sequence that can restart something. Both the Hegemony and the Choir want it. Read the Sixth Precept before you take it.

creatures.sayClass: name it, and say the room changes
creatures.tactics: governs. It has a constituency. Its war is a policy.
creatures.weaknessText: Phase 1 is the real fight — its court is its body. Save the court and the Baron is alone in Phase 3. Desiccation and Dry regions stop its Bloom. Anything that makes a region uninhabitable starves it: this is the only Catastrophe in this book a Desiccation Specialist can beat outright.

traits.name: Region-Speaker
traits.text: its Signals reach an entire region: it can broadcast to every host it has touched across a whole locale, once per Tide

traits.name: Latent Court
traits.text: four NPCs it has already touched — use established faces; the Cohort may save them rather than kill them, and this is the intended ending of the fight

specials.name: Bloom Trigger
specials.text: every Vector, Insert, and controlled organism within a region activates at once (Core Atlas, Pathogen Scout's Stage III at region scale, −1 EV each).

specials.name: Grant Audience
specials.text: it will negotiate. It wants three things: safe passage out of the region, a host it can keep, and the Cohort's silence. It will pay in Terminal Codon and truths.

morale.stops: withdraws when revealed or at "failing"
morale.note: It needs a host more than a win.

creatures.name: Crystal Growth

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: raw salt of the best grade: 3 S per Segment, and the base of every Neutraliser

creatures.sayClass: a swarm, a cluster, a shoal: name its body
creatures.tactics: makes the battlefield worse and waits.
creatures.weaknessText: water (a Hypotonic zone dissolves it), Thermal, and patience: it cannot follow you.

traits.name: Salt-Bloom
traits.text: at the end of each Cycle it grows 1 Segment if it is in Hypertonic or Dry ground; it also crystallises the ground: the zone becomes rough — viscosity +1 for everyone else

traits.name: Brittle
traits.text: Thermal damage removes Segments 1-for-1, no Overflow needed

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Turgor Ram

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: the ram organ is the source of the Momentum property on Weight Apparatus; a Smith pays 40 S

creatures.tactics: chooses the charge lane before the fight starts. Watch where it positions in Cycle 1 and you will know where it intends to kill someone.
creatures.weaknessText: brace, Anchor, Gel terrain (kills its Momentum), and being not where it wants you to be: a Rider or Navigator can spend its charge for you.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: 3+ Drifts in a straight line then Strike: +2 dice and +4 damage — Momentum, exactly as Core IV

traits.name: Dense
traits.text: cannot be pushed by anything with VSC less than 4

specials.name: Gore-and-Throw
specials.text: on a hit, the target is thrown one band and takes 6 Kinetic; if it strikes a wall or structure, +8 Kinetic and the structure takes 10.

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Flaccid Haunter

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: the drain organ: +2 Osmotic soak, and the raw material of every Siphon graft

creatures.tactics: grapples the armoured one, drains them, and lets their own soak fail them.
creatures.weaknessText: Mucoid family (immune to its drain), Desiccation (it cannot draw from something already dry), and any build with low ATP expenditure — a pure Strike-and-Drift Cohort starves it out.

traits.name: Wither
traits.text: a hit inflicts Flaccid: −2 VSC and reach −1 for 2 Cycles; the Haunter prefers armour, because armoured organisms have the most water to draw

traits.name: Leak
traits.text: its own body vents: everything in Contact takes 3 Osmotic at the end of its turn

specials.name: Pressure Drain
specials.text: a target in Contact loses 3 ATP and the Haunter gains the difference as temporary MI (max 15).

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Pore Breaker

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: its bore-organ is worth 120 S to a Hegemony foundry; the Warden Circles consider possession of one a felony

creatures.tactics: ignores the Cohort and dismantles the building they are standing in.
creatures.weaknessText: do not fight it inside anything you want to keep. It cannot break what is already open, so fight it in the open water where its special is wasted.

traits.name: Membrane-Eater
traits.text: it can Strike structures, walls, doors, Folds, and hatches: such objects use MT 5, braced 8; its hits add +8 damage against them

traits.name: Breacher
traits.text: a struck structure gains a hole: a new opening, and the region's pressure differential then does the rest — 10 Osmotic and a band shift for anything nearby

specials.name: Flood
specials.text: it opens a wall deliberately: 3 band shift toward the breach and 14 Osmotic to everything in the path.

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Tidal Anchor

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: anchor tissue: +2 Bulk capacity, and the base of Pore Locks and Brace Node grafts

creatures.tactics: becomes the terrain and dare you to cross.
creatures.weaknessText: do not be dragged: Anchor and Immovable features, bracing, and holding onto a Protein Weaver's sheet. Kill it from Far (MT 15 is the lowest Elite-adjacent number in the Order) — this is the Order's glass cannon, in the sense that it is a fortress with no windows.

traits.name: Immoveable
traits.text: cannot be pushed, thrown, or relocated by any means; it refuses

traits.name: Channel
traits.text: it sets the flow in its own band and adjacent bands: it can reverse it once per Cycle — the current in the fight is its action

specials.name: Undertow
specials.text: everything in a 5-Drift line is dragged 2 bands toward it and takes 8 Osmotic; anyone who hits a hazard takes it at +2.

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Salt Horror

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: its salts are Legendary-grade reagents: a Smith or Engineer will empty the Cohort's purse for them

creatures.tactics: makes the region unlivable, then waits for the Cohort to come to it.
creatures.weaknessText: water (in a Hypotonic zone its aura inverts: −2 to its own pools and it must move constantly), Thermal, and Desiccation Specialists (a Dry Zone steals its economy entirely — the two of them are natural enemies and the Bestiary's most interesting duel).

traits.name: Desiccating Aura
traits.text: a 4-Drift zone: Hypertonic rules for non-Barophils — DFF pools −2, PP −1, heals halved — and every creature starting its turn inside gives the Horror 2 Substrate

traits.name: Salt Armour
traits.text: Lytic damage against it is reduced by 4; Thermal burns it for +4

specials.name: Brine Lance
specials.text: a line attack: 12 Osmotic, target becomes Flaccid, and the ground along the line crystallises into a Crystal Growth (Swarmling) that persists.

specials.name: Ransom
specials.text: it trades: water for information, passage, or Specimens. It is reasonable, patient, and will absolutely honour the deal. It will also follow you for three Beats to make sure you do not lie.

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Desiccation Hulk

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.tactics: turns a fight into an attrition test and knows exactly how much MI each side has left.
creatures.weaknessText: its own special punishes it in water (fight it in a current); Desiccation immunity gear; a Weaver's sheet-wall can block its aura's line of effect.

traits.name: Thirst Body
traits.text: healing and regeneration do not work on it while it is in a Dry or Hypertonic zone; in water it regenerates 4 MI/Cycle

traits.name: Slaking
traits.text: each time it takes Osmotic damage, its next Strike gains +2 BD and drains 3 MI extra

specials.name: Dry Out
specials.text: a 6-Drift zone becomes Dry for 3 Cycles: no healing for anyone, no regeneration, no Segment regrowth, no spore or hazard creation, and every Sustained Reaction costs +1 ATP.

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Brine Colossus

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: three hazard organs: a Weaver's dream, a Smith's year's work, and the reason a foundry would fund a Cohort's entire Vector

creatures.tactics: arrives and makes the whole encounter about physics.
creatures.weaknessText: it is slow: MT 17 is high but its pools are only 8 dice and a Cohort with range can ignore it for four Cycles; Desiccation strips its hazards; Thermal to the Cold layer, Lytic to the Acidic layer — it must be disassembled element by element.

traits.name: Weight of the World
traits.text: Vast: attacks against it from Mid or farther are at −1 die; it cannot be pushed; its Momentum hits deal +8 and throw two bands

traits.name: Layered
traits.text: its body is stratified: it is simultaneously Hypertonic, Acidic, and Cold — three hazards at once, all in Contact

specials.name: Ballast
specials.text: it anchors a region: for 3 Cycles nothing in a 10-Drift zone can be pushed, thrown, or displaced — including the Cohort's own tactics. This shuts down Riders, Brutes, and Navigators at once.

specials.name: Rime
specials.text: 8 Osmotic to a band, and the band becomes viscous for 2 Cycles (PP +1 cost for everyone).

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Deep Pressure Horror

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.tactics: walks into your site, reads its seams, and opens the one that hurts most.
creatures.weaknessText: open water with nothing sealed (its signature special is wasted), Anomaly effects, and leaving the region: it cannot follow into low pressure without losing 3 soak and 2 BD. A Cohort that retreats to the Mid-Strata has beaten it.

traits.name: Pressure Legibility
traits.text: it knows every sealed space within 10 Drifts and which of them can be opened; its fight-plan is structural

traits.name: Barophil-Hard
traits.text: thermal and pressure hazards do nothing to it; cold effects fail

specials.name: Implosion
specials.text: one sealed or braced space within 10 Drifts fails: 20 Kinetic to everything within 6 Drifts, every structure in the zone loses half integrity, and everything not braced is thrown 2 bands.

specials.name: Brace Denial
specials.text: for 2 Cycles, bracing gives no benefit in its zone. (This is the counter to the entire anti-Brute strategy. It is why this block is T5.)

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Vacuole Behemoth

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.sayClass: name it, and say the room changes
creatures.tactics: it is a place that becomes a fight when robbed. It has time. It has always had time.
creatures.weaknessText: do not fight the sac: open it, take what is inside, and leave; Phase 3 is a conversation. Thermal and Desiccation both weaken its store. It cannot move fast: a Cohort that stays out of Contact for six Cycles can simply end the encounter by leaving with the treasure, which is the correct answer and the one players rarely think of.

traits.name: Living Vault
traits.text: its interior holds sealed things: old dead in perfect state, a Nucleoid sample, a Warden key — the Cohort can cut things out mid-fight with a Synthesis contest at AT 20, and each cut ends one of its phase options

traits.name: Pressure Store
traits.text: each Cycle it grows: +10 MI; at Phase 2's start it vents: 24 Osmotic to a 10-Drift zone

specials.name: Empty the Sac
specials.text: it releases one stored hazard, creature, or object per PP spent, at full strength. This is a tool the Cohort can turn on the Behemoth's enemies if they negotiate.

specials.name: Storage Law
specials.text: it does not attack organisms that present a valid Warden storage token. This is a whole solution to the encounter.

morale.stops: when the Cohort has left its ground
morale.note: It wants the space, not the kill.

creatures.name: Antigen Gnat

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: Warden inquisitors buy intact Gnats at 25 S: they are reagents, and a Cohort that harvests them is technically selling surveillance equipment

creatures.sayClass: a swarm, a cluster, a shoal: name its body
creatures.tactics: swarms the biggest chemical signal in the room and paints the target for the real fight.
creatures.weaknessText: area effects, Desiccation, and simply not being hit: they must touch to Mark, so Reactive Osmosis and MT denial work well.

morale.stops: never; scatters only if thrown past Loose

weakTo: not being touched: Deflect and a high Membrane Threshold
ladder: a loose cloud of rust-bright motes
hitWords: a mote lands, and you can feel yourself being read
the cloud brushes you and brightens
missWords: it orbits and does not land
the cloud parts round the swing
look: It goes to the loudest body in the room.
Its touch does not hurt; it paints you for the others.
Kill one and the rest come faster.

creatures.name: Clonal Sentinel

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact
harvest.note: clone tissue is the basis of every Immunosuppression graft: Antigen Hood, and the Hegemony pays well for it

creatures.tactics: a squad of identical bodies, each one cheap, all of them smarter than the last.
creatures.weaknessText: spread the damage across different targets — Clonals share what they learn, which means a Cohort using one damage type hands the whole squad a resistance by Cycle 2. Rotate damage types.

traits.name: Clone-Sync
traits.text: all Clonals in range share one Mark pool: a Mark on one is a Mark on all, and when one learns a resistance — +2 soak vs one type — all of them have it

traits.name: Recognise
traits.text: free action: knows whether an organism is registered, masked, or altered

specials.name: Escalate
specials.text: after an ally hits the same target twice, the second ally's next Strike gains +2 dice (a two-person Cascade, and the entry point to Immunan tactics).

morale.stops: withdraws to report at "failing" or when its squad is gone
morale.note: A report is worth more than a death.

creatures.name: Phagocyte Marshal

harvest.requires: destroyed; harvester Up and at Contact

creatures.tactics: protects the registers and arrests the problem. It would genuinely rather arrest you.
creatures.weaknessText: split it from its charges (push, shear, a Rider); Lytic damage against a Marshal carrying a prisoner is a way to kill the prisoner too — the Cohort will have to decide.

traits.name: Bulwark
